column1: # Signal regression correction: the manifest the regressions scope runs and is judged by.
# scripts/signal_review.sh builds each run's -only-testing list from this file, and
# scripts/signal_regressions_results.py checks every row against the logs of the build.
# Columns (tab-separated): order, device, run, bundle, test, kind.
#   device  main = the selected iPhone 17 Pro Max; b = device B, its clone
#           "iPhone 17 Pro Max (signal review B)". Both run iOS 26.5 on the same host, in parallel.
#   run     one bounded xcodebuild test-without-building, in this order on its device; within a run
#           XCTest orders the tests by class, then by name, which is the order listed here.
#   kind    required = one of the 27 required regression executions of build 6ab7ee20's manifest
#           same device as there; the four Welcome tests moved from the selected simulator to device
#           B (the same model and runtime) to balance the two lanes.
#           repeat = a planned second execution of a required test from a fresh app and test-runner
#           state, to check repeatability. It is not a new unique test and not a retry;
#           it runs only if the time budget allows both it and the run after it.
# Automatic retries are off for every run. A failed, skipped, interrupted or missing required
# execution fails the verdict; so does a repeat that runs and does not pass.
